instagram_caption:
Jesus... tomorrow I have to tell my parents I am leaving the course they paid for. How do I even start that sentence? 😭

My dad worked double shifts for this. I keep practising the sentence and I cannot get through it without crying.

"You are not crying because you are unsure. You are crying because you love them."

"Tell Me honestly. Are you running from something hard, or walking toward something true?"

"Then say it plainly and let them have their first reaction. Their first reaction is not their final one."

"I am not asking you to stop needing them. I am telling you that if their arms close, Mine do not."

"Though my father and mother forsake me, the Lord will receive me."
Psalms 27:10 (NIV)

💬 Have you ever had to disappoint someone you love to be honest? 🙏 Say it kindly, say it anyway.
youtube_title: Jesus, I Have To Disappoint My Parents Tomorrow 😭 | Psalm 27:10 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus... tomorrow I have to tell my parents I am leaving the course they paid for. How do I even start that sentence? 😭

Her father worked double shifts to pay for the course she is about to leave. She has one sentence to say and cannot finish it.

Her: Jesus... tomorrow I have to tell my parents I am leaving the course they paid for. How do I even start that sentence? 😭

Her: My dad worked double shifts for this. I keep practising the sentence and I cannot get through it without crying.

Jesus: You are not crying because you are unsure. You are crying because you love them.

Her: Everyone says follow your heart. Nobody says what to do when following it breaks the people who gave you everything.

Jesus: Tell Me honestly. Are you running from something hard, or walking toward something true?

Her: Walking toward. I am sure of that part. I am just not sure I can survive their faces.

Jesus: Then say it plainly and let them have their first reaction. Their first reaction is not their final one.

Her: And if it is? If they never look at me the same way again?

Jesus: I am not asking you to stop needing them. I am telling you that if their arms close, Mine do not.

"Though my father and mother forsake me, the Lord will receive me."
Psalms 27:10 (NIV)

Jesus's Replies — the questions you actually ask, answered in His words.

Have you ever had to disappoint someone you love to be honest? 🙏 Say it kindly, say it anyway.
